data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2018 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 411.211m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net adverse prior-year development of approximately GBP 21.4m (c.5.2% of opening gross claims), reflecting adverse development principally in Professional Lines and Energy, partially offset by favourable development across other classes. The 2016 year was closed by reinsurance to close into Syndicate 2008 (a reported loss of GBP 49.3m). The movement was calculated from the syndicate's gross claims development table and is consistent with narrative commentary in the technical provisions note.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 68.9m (2017: GBP 165.8m) is a deterioration of GBP 3.3m (2017: deterioration of GBP 11.5m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Professional Lines and Energy with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.
As part of ASL's non-life underwriting strategy the 2016 year of account has closed by way of a reinsurance to close arrangement into Syndicate 2008, ... at a loss of GBP 49.3m.
In 2017 the Syndicate incurred significant losses from the Harvey, Irma and Maria hurricanes.
There was continued adverse performance on the Accident & Health, Marine, Property Binders, Product Damage & Breakdown and Non-Marine Liability classes.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year movement (21.374m) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross basis) as the report does not provide a single explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' figure. The report includes narrative net deterioration (GBP 3.3m) which is net of reinsurance; the triangle-based gross calculation was used per methodology rules. A reinsurance-to-close of the 2016 year (closure into Syndicate 2008, loss GBP 49.3m) is present in the report and may distort comparisons; this has been noted. All monetary amounts were extracted from tables presented in GBP '000 and converted to millions.
